notes.title: Morriton Manor Stories: Nordic Whispers Live Stream
notes.content:
[h3]About Morriton Manor Stories: Nordic Whispers[/h3][p]A mystery detective game with RPG elements. Cursed by demonic forces, a mysterious island is trapped in a time loop. Leah Glessner, Private Investigator of the Supernatural, uses her unique gift of photographic memory to confront evil. Skill your character. Investigate. Solve the case. [/p][p][/p][h3]Dev insights & gameplay[/h3][p]Marcus (Writing, Game Design, Programming), Matze (Art) and Hauke (Writing, Game Design) talk about the development of the game.

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3012400/Morriton_Manor_Stories_Nordic_Whispers//"]Watch the broadcast on the store page[/url][/p]
